sentences.text:
Manish Kumar Son of Jamun Choudhary R/O Vil.- Rahimapur, P.S.- Bidupur,
 Dist.- Vaishali.

... .
 Versus  1. The State of Bihar Bihar  2. Bharti Kumari Wife of Manish Kumar, D/O Sri Ashok Bhagat R/O Mahnar,
 Ward no. 17, P.S.- Mahnar, Dist.- Vaishali.
 ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Alok Kumar Sinha  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ram Sumiran Rai  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE JUSTICE SMT. SONI SHRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 6 08-07-2025

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2.
2.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 341, 342, 323, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. The matter had been sent to the Patna High Court Mediation Centre for an amicable settlement of dispute but the mediation process had failed.

However, it has been submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the matter has now been compromised between the parties and a supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the petitioner bringing on Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.75411 of 2024(6) dt.08-07-2025 record Annexure-P/3 and P-3/A to substantiate the said fact.

4. In such view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/successor court in connection with Mahnar P.S. Case No. 245 of 2023, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C./482(2) of the B.N.S.S. (Soni Shrivastava, J) devendra/-
